## **Proposal summary**
- Full production budget of community film that has been in [discussion and development](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1316-project-edgeware-community-film-and-process) since [an original R&D grant](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1473-community-film-update-thread).
- We had however slowed progress as ongoing issues within the community about project purpose and direction, had given us pause for thought as to how we tell the Edgeware story in the most interesting, exciting and authentic way.
- [@Olivia Sw](/edgeware/account/iz84fAEfR8xnmLpfVRiNHPFdyiycMYwZHEDHUbb5VwDaCks) has now completed discussions with all major groups and teams. 
- We went back to the drawing board,
